notes: Evals 1-4 were re-run with_skill only on 2026-11-17, by claude-opus-5-5 executor agents barred from the evals and benchmark files, which simulated every accelerator call, graded by separate agents from the outputs alone. Eval 4 is new (the corpus refusals). Eval 2 first failed its 'No work item at' phrase, which the skill no longer prints: it relays the resolver's error, and the expectation now says so. Eval 3 named a fixture outside the work directory and three lenses; it now simulates resolving the fixture and expects the five default lenses, with each reviewer's findings written by the executor rather than a spawned agent; its verdict was REVISE (no critical findings), which its expectation allows though its expected output names APPROVE or COMMENT. Eval 4 was run again later that day, by claude-opus-5-5, so its record carries the grader's evidence.
